title: dev.qory.session.transcript
description: One chunk of the transcript file of a runtime's session, for a runtime whose descriptor has resume: whole lines as the runtime appends them, each masked as a dev.qory.run.log chunk is, cut at 32768 bytes. The transcript is the chunks of one path in sequence order. Each run's chunks start at offset 0 and cover the whole file, the lines a continuation restored included. A gap in offset means the file cannot be restored.

session.description: The number of the session whose runtime wrote the file, from 1. The chunk lies between that session's dev.qory.session.started and dev.qory.session.exited.

session_id.description: The runtime's session id, as dev.qory.runtime.started has it.

path.description: The file's path under the descriptor's resume.prefix: under the runtime's home, such as ~/.claude/projects/-workspace/<session_id>.jsonl, or absolute, such as /var/lib/qory-codex-home/sessions/2026/11/13/rollout-<time>-<session_id>.jsonl.

offset.description: The position of the chunk's first byte in the masked file: the sum of the sizes of the run's earlier chunks of this path.

bytes.description: The chunk, base64, 1 to 32768 bytes before the encoding.
